==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=QuestPDF&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using QuestPDF.Infrastructure;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.QuestPDF: QuestPDF throws on the first generated document until a licence type is
        // set. Community covers open source and small business use; above their revenue threshold a
        // paid key is needed instead.
        QuestPDF.Settings.License = LicenseType.Community;
        // Verify.QuestPDF: registers a file converter for IDocument, so verifying a document writes
        // its metadata and settings, a deterministic pdf, and a png per rendered page.
        // The call is explicit because the class is named VerifyQuestPdf, and plugin discovery looks
        // for a type named after the assembly, VerifyQuestPDF, so it never finds this one.
        VerifyQuestPdf.Initialize();

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/QuestPDFTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=QuestPDF&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using QuestPDF.Fluent;
using QuestPDF.Helpers;
using QuestPDF.Infrastructure;
using VerifyQuestPDF;

// Verify.QuestPDF: Verifies a QuestPDF IDocument: a metadata and settings snapshot, a deterministic pdf, and a png per page.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.QuestPDF
// Note: The plugin class is named VerifyQuestPdf and discovery looks for VerifyQuestPDF, so
// InitializePlugins() alone never enables it and the explicit call is required.
// Note: QuestPDF.Settings.License has to be set before any document is generated.
// Note: Pages are rasterized through Skia, so they vary with the OS and the installed fonts. Pair
// them with VerifierSettings.UseSsimForPng() or an image comparer.
// Note: PagesToInclude trims only the png pages; the .verified.pdf is always the whole document.
// Note: Metadata is left out of the info snapshot when the document sets no metadata members.
// Note: It registers a file converter on IDocument rather than a pdf stream converter, so the pdf
// it emits is what another pdf plugin would then process.
// Note: PagesToInclude and SkipPdfNormalization are defined in the VerifyTests namespace by
// several pdf plugins, so the samples call the static form.
public class QuestPDFTests
{
    // An IDocument is verified directly: QuestPDF generates the pdf, and the snapshot is the
    // page count and the document settings, beside the pdf and the rendered pages.
    // The creation and modified dates are pinned before generation, so the bytes are stable.
    [Fact]
    public Task VerifyDocument()
    {
        var document = GenerateDocument();
        return Verify(document);
    }

    // Renders only the first pages, which keeps the png count down for a long report. The pdf
    // target is unaffected and always holds the whole document.
    // The static form is used because several pdf plugins define PagesToInclude in the
    // VerifyTests namespace, and the fluent call is then ambiguous (CS0121).
    [Fact]
    public Task PagesToInclude()
    {
        var document = GenerateDocument();
        var settings = new VerifySettings();
        QuestPDFSettings.PagesToInclude(settings, 1);
        return Verify(document, settings);
    }

    // The delegate overload picks pages by number, for a report where only some pages matter.
    // ShouldIncludePage lives in the VerifyQuestPDF namespace, not in VerifyTests.
    [Fact]
    public Task PagesToIncludeDynamic()
    {
        var document = GenerateDocument();
        var settings = new VerifySettings();
        ShouldIncludePage include = pageNumber => pageNumber % 2 == 1;
        QuestPDFSettings.PagesToInclude(settings, include);
        return Verify(document, settings);
    }

    // Generating the pdf is expensive and committing it is not always wanted. This drops the
    // pdf target, leaving the info snapshot and the rendered pages.
    [Fact]
    public Task ExcludePdf()
    {
        var document = GenerateDocument();
        return Verify(document)
            .ExcludeTargets("pdf");
    }

    // Stands in for a real report. The document is built in code, so the samples need no
    // fixture file and a change to the layout shows up in the snapshot.
    static IDocument GenerateDocument() =>
        Document.Create(
            _ => _.Page(
                page =>
                {
                    page.Size(PageSizes.A4);
                    page.Margin(2, Unit.Centimetre);
                    page.Header()
                        .Text("Sample report");
                    page.Content()
                        .Text("Hello World!");
                }));
}


==== packages

Verify.XunitV3

==== interactions

Warning external-tool: QuestPDF needs QuestPDF licence: QuestPDF refuses to generate a document until a licence type is set. Community covers open source and small business use; commercial use above their threshold needs a paid key.
Info plugin-not-discovered: VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins() cannot find QuestPDF: it looks for a type named after the assembly, and silently skips an assembly that has none. The module initializer calls each of them explicitly, so they are enabled either way.
